name: I had a bad experience with a contractor before — what should I ask HH Remodeling first?
description: Ask about scope, communication, and change orders before anything starts. Clear paperwork and clear expectations help prevent repeat mistakes.

mainEntity.name: I had a bad experience with a contractor before — what should I ask HH Remodeling first?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you are hesitant because you had a bad remodeling experience before, focus on communication, written scope, and change-order rules before signing anything. That is the fastest way to avoid the vague pricing and surprise decisions that usually cause frustration.
